title: 第30章 私人小秘境
novel_title: 开局废灵根，成了宗门团宠小师叔
content_zh:
萧易寒轻嗤了一声，眼底闪过一抹兴趣盎然的光。

    手腕翻转间，长剑发出嗡鸣，一道暗紫色的光芒沿着剑身蔓延开来，最后化作一抹流光向着墨鳞犀疾驰而去。

    墨鳞犀低吼一声，口中猛地吐出一团蓝色的火焰。

    剑光和火焰在空中再次碰撞，这一次墨鳞犀被逼退了数步，四蹄在地上犁出四道深沟。

    然而，一切都发生在电光火石之间。

    墨鳞犀的身体停住的瞬间，两只后蹄子忽然发力，朝着顾念念冲了过去。

    萧易寒瞬间变了脸色，身体快如闪电已经到了顾念念面前。

    墨鳞犀带着狂风撞过来，萧易寒原本挡在顾念念前面的身体，忽然侧开。

    他一只手揽住顾念念的腰，另一只手用剑横在了身前。

    一人一兽，身体都保持着极快的速度，以一个奇异的角度擦肩而过。

    在错身的瞬间，萧易寒手中的长剑锋芒一闪，墨鳞犀的身体顿了一下。

    下一瞬，庞大的身体轰然倒地。

    一切都发生在转瞬之间。

    顾念念睁开眼睛，微微喘息着。

    她离开萧易寒的怀抱，转头看向身后的墨鳞犀。

    庞大的身体已经躺在地上不动了。

    八级妖兽就这么被萧易寒打败了？

    顾念念错愕地看向萧易寒。

    她是知道古魔是很厉害，可是洛师兄不是说萧易寒现在只有化神修为吗？

    八级妖兽可是相当于问鼎了。

    萧易寒就这么一招搞定了？

    萧易寒看着她吃惊的脸，嘴角弯起一个弧度，将她放了下来。

    “小师叔莫不是被吓到了？”

    顾念念尴尬地转移了视线，这才发现桃夭和小六居然被萧易寒踩在了脚底下。

    “你们……怎么……”

    她话还没说完，那两个就开始哀嚎了。

    “主人，救我！”

    “主人！”

    顾念念不太确定地看向萧易寒。

    后者冷笑一声。

    “不知道护住的都是废物。”

    原来是刚刚墨鳞犀想要偷袭顾念念的时候，这两个居然没有在第一时间护主。

    其实这一点也是有点冤枉桃夭和小六的。

    实在是谁也没想到那墨鳞犀居然会偷袭，还是防不胜防的那种。

    第二个原因是，这墨鳞犀也是十分的狡猾，居然在和萧易寒对战之前，就丢出了一颗天香果。

    这果子没什么攻击性，但是闻到气味的人会有一瞬间的神志不清，导致行动迟缓。
content_en:
Xiao Yihan snorted lightly, and a flash of interest flashed in his eyes.

    As his wrist turned, the long sword buzzed, and a dark purple light spread along the sword's blade, finally turning into a stream of light and speeding towards the black-scaled rhinoceros.

    The black-scaled rhinoceros roared and spit out a ball of blue flames from its mouth.

    The sword light and flames collided in the air again. This time, the black-scaled rhinoceros was forced back a few steps, and its four hooves plowed four deep furrows on the ground.

    However, everything happened in a flash of lightning.

    The moment the Mo Linxi's body stopped, his two hind hooves suddenly exerted force and rushed towards Gu Niannian.

    Xiao Yihan's expression changed instantly, and he was already in front of Gu Niannian as fast as lightning.

    The black-lined rhinoceros came with a strong wind, and Xiao Yihan's body that was originally blocking Gu Niannian suddenly turned sideways.

    He held Gu Niannian's waist with one hand, and held the sword in front of him with the other hand.

    One person and one beast, their bodies maintained extremely fast speeds, passing by each other at a strange angle.

    At the moment when they lost their bodies, the long sword in Xiao Yihan's hand flashed, and Mo Linxi's body paused.

    The next moment, the huge body collapsed to the ground.

    Everything happens in a blink of an eye.

    Gu Niannian opened her eyes and panted slightly.

    She left Xiao Yihan's arms and turned to look at Mo Linxi behind her.

    The huge body was lying motionless on the ground.

    The eighth-level monster was defeated by Xiao Yihan just like that?

    Gu Niannian looked at Xiao Yihan in shock.

    She knew that the ancient demon was very powerful, but didn't Senior Brother Luo say that Xiao Yihan only had the cultivation of god transformation now?

    An eighth-level monster is equivalent to aspirants.

    Xiao Yihan managed it with just one move?

    Xiao Yihan looked at her surprised face, curved the corner of his mouth, and put her down.

    "Isn't Junior Uncle scared?"

    Gu Niannian shifted her gaze in embarrassment, and then realized that Taoyao and Xiaoliu had been stepped on by Xiao Yihan.

    "You...how..."

    Before she could finish her words, the two started wailing.

    "Master, save me!"

    "Master!"

    Gu Niannian looked at Xiao Yihan uncertainly.

    The latter sneered.

    "I didn't know that the people I protected were all rubbish."

    It turned out that when Mo Linxi wanted to sneak attack Gu Niannian, these two people did not protect the master at the first time.

    In fact, this is a bit unfair to Taoyao and Xiaoliu.

    In fact, no one expected that the black-scaled rhinoceros would actually make a sneak attack, and it was hard to guard against.

    The second reason is that this black-scaled rhinoceros is also very cunning. He actually threw out a Tianxiang Fruit before fighting Xiao Yihan.

    This fruit is not offensive, but people who smell it will be confused for a moment, resulting in slow movement.
